title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
brief: Google is adding a feature to its Phone app that detects when scammers are spoofing a contact's phone number, alerting users to suspicious calls impersonating people they know. The capability is part of Google's June Android update, which also includes cross-platform AirDrop support, expanded Personal Safety for children, and AI-powered clothing try-on in Photos.
